semiconductor_relevance: High — SHI-ATEX provides specialized ion implantation services crucial for enhancing the performance of power semiconductor wafers.
summary: SHI-ATEX Co., Ltd. specializes in light ion implantation services for silicon and silicon carbide power semiconductor wafers. Their services enhance electrical characteristics and optimize material performance, leveraging expertise in radiation utilization and testing technologies.
capabilities: Light ion implantation for Si and SiC wafers
Localized defect and donor layer creation

regional_presence.Japan: SHI-ATEX operates two centers in the Kanto and Kansai regions, providing a mutual backup system for electron beam services.
